exposure: blood loss >1000 mL during cesarean deliveries
cohort: 10,781 Saudi women admitted to the labor or delivery units between January 2011 and December 2019
finding: The rate of perinatal and maternal mortality was relatively low and equivalent between booked and un-booked mothers.
mod_finding: Unbooked mothers had higher incidences of blood loss >1000 mL during cesarean deliveries but a lower episiotomy rate.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome but not specified
